verdict.rationale: Omnara is a managed-agents platform. Agents are defined in YAML config and launched programmatically via CLI, REST API or SDK. They run on hosted or connected machines, keep their history across crashes and disconnects, can queue their next task, and can spawn subagents, so background autonomous agent runs are well supported. However, nothing shows true 'automations': there is no scheduling (cron), and no inbound event triggers that start agents on their own; the documented webhooks are outbound event notifications. Missing for 10: scheduled or recurring runs, inbound trigger-based automation setup, independent hands-on corroboration of unattended background runs.
